source_text: WHO guidelines specify that VMMC targets males aged 10 years and older in priority settings, prioritizing adolescents and adult men aged 15–49 where HIV incidence is high, with services required to be provided by trained health professionals under aseptic conditions to minimize complications, which occur at rates below 2% in program data. [2]
